subject: POC: Stellar Commerce — POC plan, success criteria, and risk tracker
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@stellarcommerce.com>, Kyle Barnes <kyle@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Hi Jane / Kyle,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and really excited about a lightweight POC to validate latency and quality for your search ranking use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we discussed / success criteria (draft):
- Inference latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token queries
- Throughput: sustain 50 qps for baseline dataset
- Relevance uplift: +8% NDCG@10 on your dev set vs current model
- No PII leakage in generated outputs (pass our automated filter on provided sample)

POC scope & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize data access and NDA addendum (if needed)
- Week 1–2: ingest sample dataset and run baseline runs (Dev + Stellar)
- Week 3: evaluation and tune; handoff findings and recommendations
- Week 4: wrap + decision/next steps

Owners:
- Redwood: Dev Patel (technical lead), Marissa Cole (commercial/coordination)
- Stellar: Jane Doe (product lead), Kyle Barnes (engineering lead)

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC_plan (POC_plan.pdf) and a living risk tracker (risk_tracker.xlsx) that we'll keep updated.

Action items (for this week):
1) Jane/Kyle: confirm dataset access method (S3 vs SFTP) and point of contact for engineering (reply to this thread)
2) Rishi: I'll loop you in on the commercial note — potential trial credits and terms
3) Dev: please confirm resource availability for week 1–3 and add any initial tech risks to tracker

If that looks good I'll mark this as the working plan and set up the kickoff call for Monday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Barnes <kyle@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and aligns with our internal expectations. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Dataset access: we'll provision an S3 read-only bucket and share credentials with Dev.
- Success criteria: the NDCG target looks good, but can we add a secondary metric for query latency under 95th < 300ms during peak? Our SRE wants a slightly more relaxed guardrail for initial runs.
- Data retention: we need to confirm retention window for logs (14 days) — we cannot keep raw logs for more than that without a DS review.

I've attached a short doc with the success criteria we used internally (POC_Success_Criteria.docx).

We'll confirm access by EOD Thursday. Kickoff for Monday works for Kyle and me.

—Jane
Jane Doe
Director, Product — Search
Stellar Commerce

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@stellarcommerce.com>, Kyle Barnes <kyle@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Hi Jane / Kyle — thanks, looking forward to the kickoff. A few technical notes and owners so we don't lose them: 

Technical plan (short):
- Ingest: we'll mount the S3 bucket and run a one-off ingestion to convert to our internal eval format. ETA: 48 hours after creds.
- Baseline runs: run Redwood-verified model v2.1 and your current baseline for apples-to-apples.
- Eval infra: we'll spin a small dedicated instance (m5-like for orchestration + 1x A100 for inference) for the duration of the POC.

Known risks (initial):
- Data schema mismatch: if the sample contains nested fields we may need a short munging step (low risk, 1–2 days).
- Rate limiting on your S3 creds: please ensure the bucket policy allows sustained reads.
- Latency variability in dev environment: we'll capture p95/p99 and annotate if noisy.

Owners (technical):
- Ingest & pipeline: Dev Patel (redwood)
- Evaluation scripts & metrics: Lukas Meyer (redwood)
- Customer infra contact: Kyle Barnes (stellar)

I've uploaded a suggested evaluation plan (poc_evaluation_plan.pdf) to the Confluence page and attached a PDF here. I'll create the first row in the risk_tracker.xlsx with the items above.

Thanks — I'll update this thread once creds arrive and we've completed the first ingest.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Appreciate the clarity, everyone. Updated plan below with the small change to p95 latency guardrail (95th < 300ms as Jane suggested) and confirmation of retention window (14 days). I've also attached the current risk tracker (risk_tracker.xlsx) — please add rows as issues are discovered and mark status (open / mitigated / closed).

Confirmed timeline: kickoff Monday 2026-11-29 10:00 PT; ingest to complete by 2026-12-01; baseline runs by 2026-12-03; evaluation complete by 2026-12-08.

Immediate asks:
- Kyle: send S3 creds and test object path before EOD Friday 11/27
- Dev/Lukas: confirm you'll reserve the A100 slot for 11/29–12/08
- Jane: we'll need a sample of the dev query set (5000 queries) by 12/01

Next steps: I'll schedule the kickoff and share calendar invites; keeping Rishi looped for any contractual/credits notes.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Barnes <kyle@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Quick update — we provided S3 creds and started the ingest. Early run hit a blocker: one of our transformation scripts is failing when Redwood's ingest tries to normalize a nested metadata field. I've attached the integration logs (integration_logs.zip) showing the stack.

Impact: ingest failed and baseline runs are blocked until we can either (a) update the transform on our side or (b) have Redwood perform a quick pre-processing step. Can we triage?

—Jane

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@stellarcommerce.com>, Kyle Barnes <kyle@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps + draft plan (recap from today)

Thanks for flagging this, Jane — sorry for the interruption. I've updated the risk tracker (row #3) and set status to OPEN: "ingest transform failure — nested metadata". Proposed mitigation options: 

1) Short-term (fastest): Redwood performs a 24-hour pre-processing step to flatten the nested fields and provide a sanitized dataset to Stellar for review. Estimated effort: ~6 engineering hours (Dev + Lukas).
2) Customer-side fix: Stellar updates the transform script; estimate depends on their dev bandwidth (would likely take 1–2 days).

Escalation path: if we cannot unblock within 24 hours we will escalate to Engineering Lead for priority A100 time and potentially extend the POC timeline by 48–72 hours. Rishi, please advise if we should offer a one-week timeline cushion or trial credit if timeline slips.

Action items (next 24 hrs):
- Dev/Lukas: confirm availability to run the pre-processing (reply by 16:00 PT today)
- Kyle: confirm whether Stellar wants Redwood to run the pre-processing or if you'll push a quick fix
- Jane: we'll track progress in risk_tracker.xlsx; please upload any additional error logs to the Confluence folder.

I'm marking this high priority and will follow up once Dev confirms.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
